title: Crate Sorter

reward.description: Hold it to your eye and the world lines up neatly, smallest to largest.

hints: Copy the list first (crates[:] or list(crates)) so you don't change the original.
merge: keep an index into each list. Repeatedly take the smaller front item. When one list runs out, add the rest of the other.
merge_sort: if the list has 0 or 1 items it's already sorted. Otherwise split it in half, merge_sort each half, then merge them.
